# Mind and Method Academy

> Skills you can learn. Knowledge you can use.

Mind and Method Academy is a UK-based training and coaching provider for individuals and organisations. We offer practical learning in entrepreneurship, professional and personal development, and artificial intelligence through established programmes and tailored training.

## Who We Serve

- **Individuals:** People looking to develop practical skills for work, business and everyday life, including those exploring entrepreneurship.
- **Organisations:** Employers, educational institutions, councils, charities and other organisations seeking practical training for their staff, students or communities.

## Training Areas

- **Entrepreneurship:** Business planning, customers, pricing, finance, marketing, sales and business operations. Includes the six-week Business Builder programme.
- **Professional & Personal Development:** Leadership, management, communication, negotiation, public speaking, confidence and related skills.
- **Artificial Intelligence:** Practical AI skills and tools for work, business and everyday life, including responsible and effective use.

## How We Deliver Training

- **Established programmes:** Workshops, courses and coaching that individuals or organisations can access.
- **Tailored training:** Training developed around an organisation's needs, learners and objectives.

## About

The experience behind Mind and Method Academy includes over 15 years of coaching and teaching across three continents.

Registered in England and Wales. Company No. 16932969. ICO Reg. ZC073024.
